description.la: Opuscula minora Bernardi: Prologus in Antiphonarium (De cantu), Officium de S. Victore, Chartae, Opuscula duo, Formula confessionis, Parabolae, Sententiae.
description.en-US: Bernard’s shorter pieces gathered from Migne: the prologue to the Cistercian antiphonary (on chant), the office of Saint Victor, charters, two short opuscula, a formula of private confession, the Parables and the Sentences. The Latin is the Maurist text in Migne (Patrologia Latina 182–184). Latin only, from the Maurist text in Migne, a machine-corrected OCR.
description.pt-BR: Peças menores de Bernardo reunidas de Migne: o prólogo do antifonário cisterciense (sobre o canto), o ofício de São Vítor, cartas patentes, dois opúsculos, uma fórmula de confissão privada, as Parábolas e as Sentenças.

la.editor: Jean Mabillon, in J.-P. Migne (Patrologia Latina 182-184)

sources.edition: S. Bernardi Claraevallensis abbatis opera omnia, ed. J. Mabillon, in Migne, Patrologia Latina 182-184 (Paris 1854); TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), works 6152, 6212, 6149, 6161, 6175, 6213, 6215, from machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: One group per feast or piece, as the Corpus Corporum divides them. PL page breaks and column numbers are dropped, and so are the paragraph numbers; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed.
sources.tierEvidence: Bernard died in 1153; Migne’s printing is public domain everywhere.
